name: Baldur's Gate
title: Baldur's Gate: Metropolis of the Coast
description: Baldur's Gate is the largest metropolis on the Sword Coast. A city of history and ambition, it stands as a gateway to the western heartlands.
wiki: Located at the mouth of the River Chionthar, Baldur's Gate is a massive trading city regulated by the Council of Four. It is divided into the Upper, Lower, and Outer Cities.
